title: When desire keeps calling itself wisdom
issueStatement: The appetite always has a reason ready: security, beauty, relief, prudence, reward. But after each new reason is obeyed, the heart is still unsettled.
centralInsight: Gurbani exposes greed by asking what actually remains. False wealth fattens anxiety; true wealth travels with the soul and teaches the hand to open.
practicalReflection: Greed is not only having too much. It is the inability to believe that enough can exist while the Giver is still near.
actionPrompt: Before the next grasping move, ask what you are afraid will happen if you stop taking more than this moment actually needs.
